WITH MONTHS AS ( SELECT LEVEL AS MONTH FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ) SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.MONTH = 1 THEN D.MONTHLY_INCOME END),0) AS JAN, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.MONTH = 2 THEN D.MONTHLY_INCOME END),0) AS FEB, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.MONTH = 3 THEN D.MONTHLY_INCOME END),0) AS MAR, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.MONTH = 4 THEN D.MONTHLY_INCOME END),0) AS APR, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.MONTH = 5 THEN D.MONTHLY_INCOME END),0) AS MAY, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.MONTH = 6 THEN D.MONTHLY_INCOME END),0) AS JUN, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.MONTH = 7 THEN D.MONTHLY_INCOME END),0) AS JUL, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.MONTH = 8 THEN D.MONTHLY_INCOME END),0) AS AUG, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.MONTH = 9 THEN D.MONTHLY_INCOME END),0) AS SEP, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.MONTH = 10 THEN D.MONTHLY_INCOME END),0) AS OCT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.MONTH = 11 THEN D.MONTHLY_INCOME END),0) AS NOV, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.MONTH = 12 THEN D.MONTHLY_INCOME END),0) AS DEC FROM MONTHS M LEFT JOIN ( SELECT O.STORE_NAME, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM O.ORDER_DATE) AS ORDER_MONTH, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM O.ORDER_DATE) AS ORDER_YEAR, SUM(O.TOTAL_PRICE - O.DELIVERY_FEE) AS MONTHLY_INCOME FROM ORDER_TBL O WHERE O.STORE_NAME = #{storeName} GROUP BY O.STORE_NAME, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM O.ORDER_DATE), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM O.ORDER_DATE) ) D ON D.ORDER_MONTH = M.MONTH AND D.ORDER_YEAR = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE)

mapper.update: UPDATE SELLER_INFO_TBL S SET S.STORE_MONTHLY_FEE = ( SELECT G.COMMISSION_RATE * T.MONTHLY_INCOME FROM ( SELECT O.STORE_NAME, SUM(O.TOTAL_PRICE - O.DELIVERY_FEE) AS MONTHLY_INCOME FROM ORDER_TBL O WHERE TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') GROUP BY O.STORE_NAME ) T JOIN COMMISSION_GRADE_TBL G ON T.MONTHLY_INCOME BETWEEN G.LOSAL AND G.HISAL WHERE S.STORE_NAME = T.STORE_NAME ) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDER_TBL O WHERE O.STORE_NAME = S.STORE_NAME AND TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') )

UPDATE SELLER_INFO_TBL S SET GRADE_CODE = ( SELECT C.GRADE_NAME FROM ( SELECT O.STORE_NAME, SUM(O.TOTAL_PRICE - O.DELIVERY_FEE) AS MONTHLY_INCOME FROM ORDER_TBL O WHERE TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE,'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') GROUP BY O.STORE_NAME ) T JOIN COMMISSION_GRADE_TBL C ON T.MONTHLY_INCOME BETWEEN C.LOSAL AND C.HISAL WHERE T.STORE_NAME = S.STORE_NAME ) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDER_TBL O WHERE O.STORE_NAME = S.STORE_NAME AND TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE,'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') )
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM') AS THIS_MONTH, T.STORE_NAME, T.STORE_ID, G.COMMISSION_RATE * T.MONTHLY_INCOME AS STORE_MONTHLY_FEE FROM ( SELECT S.STORE_NAME, S.STORE_ID, SUM(O.TOTAL_PRICE - O.DELIVERY_FEE) AS MONTHLY_INCOME FROM SELLER_INFO_TBL S LEFT JOIN ORDER_TBL O ON S.STORE_NAME = O.STORE_NAME WHERE TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE,'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') GROUP BY S.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME ) T LEFT JOIN COMMISSION_GRADE_TBL G ON T.MONTHLY_INCOME BETWEEN G.LOSAL AND G.HISAL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM') AS THIS_MONTH, T.STORE_NAME, T.STORE_ID, G.COMMISSION_RATE * T.MONTHLY_INCOME AS STORE_MONTHLY_FEE FROM ( SELECT S.STORE_NAME, S.STORE_ID, SUM(O.TOTAL_PRICE - O.DELIVERY_FEE) AS MONTHLY_INCOME FROM SELLER_INFO_TBL S LEFT JOIN ORDER_TBL O ON S.STORE_NAME = O.STORE_NAME WHERE TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE,'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') GROUP BY S.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME ) T LEFT JOIN COMMISSION_GRADE_TBL G ON T.MONTHLY_INCOME BETWEEN G.LOSAL AND G.HISAL)
